text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The excitement at the Satsuki Sho was 
extraordinary. Deafening cheers erupted 
every time an Umamusume like Kitasan Black 
or Satono Crown made an appearance.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps overwhelmed by the sheer 
intensity, Duramente appeared tense in the 
waiting room. Even when spoken to, she 
couldn't hear a thing.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, she might not be able to 
deliver the "running of the strongest" 
that she so desires.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
So, the Trainer brought up a new post-race 
workout plan. She was strong. There was no 
need to dwell on how to secure a dominant 
victory anymore.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
And a promise was made. Even during the 
race, their voice would unfailingly reach 
her. Duramente replied that she would 
believe in that.
